Hi, I'm **Urvi Joshi** — a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University, with a background in business administration and experience in event management, operations, and data management.

My interests lie at the intersection of business and analytics, particularly in understanding how data can support better decision-making and solve real-world problems. Through my experience as an Ambassador Management Intern at Goodera, I coordinated corporate social responsibility initiatives, managed large-scale events, and collaborated with diverse teams across multiple organisations.

Beyond academics and work, I am passionate about hosting events, which has given me opportunities to connect with people from different backgrounds, build meaningful relationships, and expand my professional network. I enjoy bringing people together, engaging audiences, and creating memorable experiences. Having lived in different countries and experienced diverse cultures, I value new perspectives, collaboration, and continuous learning. In my free time, I enjoy dancing, travelling, and listening to music.

This site is home to my data storytelling work from ETC5523: Communicating with Data.
